cols: Single source of truth
All active projects have one unique project record and linked registers.
Governance consistency
Configured stage gates, required evidence and approvals are enforced.
Delivery predictability
Baseline, forecast, actuals and variance are visible for scope, schedule and cost.
Business value
Every approved project has measurable outcomes, benefit owners and review dates.
Operational continuity
Business-critical projects capture BIA, recovery and service transition requirements.
Resource transparency
Capacity, assignment, availability and cross-project conflicts can be viewed.
Traceability
Objectives map to requirements, deliverables, test evidence, acceptance and benefits.
Auditability
Material changes, approvals and decisions are attributable and time-stamped.
Knowledge reuse
Approved templates, SOPs, guides, process flows and lessons learned are searchable.
AI productivity
AI-generated artefacts are sourced, reviewable, versioned and approval-controlled.

Availability
Target service availability shall be agreed by service tier; proposed production baseline 99.9% monthly excluding approved maintenance.
Performance
95th percentile common page/API response target under 3 seconds at agreed load; long-running operations asynchronous.
Scalability
Support configurable growth in users, portfolios, projects, work items, documents and audit events; validate load profile.
Concurrency
Support concurrent editing with conflict detection or controlled locking for critical baselines and approvals.
Recovery
Define RTO/RPO per platform service tier and test backup restoration and DR procedures.
Security
Complete threat modelling, secure SDLC, vulnerability scanning and independent security testing before production.
Accessibility
Target WCAG 2.2 AA for primary user journeys, subject to formal accessibility assessment.
Usability
Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile layouts; minimise duplicate entry; provide contextual help and validation.
Compatibility
Support current enterprise-approved versions of major browsers; publish supported-version matrix.
Maintainability
Modular architecture, documented APIs, automated tests, observability and controlled deployment.
Interoperability
Import/export common structured formats and maintain documented APIs.
Auditability
Searchable audit records with retention and export controls.
Localization
Support configurable language, date, time, number, currency and timezone formats.
Data integrity
Enforce referential integrity, transaction boundaries, validation and recovery from partial failures.
Observability
Central logs, metrics, traces, health checks, alerting and integration monitoring.
Portability
Provide complete authorised export of project data, documents and relationships in documented formats.
A project can be created from intake, assigned an identifier and progressed through configured gates with required evidence.
A user can navigate from portfolio objective to project, requirement, work item, test, acceptance and benefit record.
Approved scope, schedule and budget baselines are preserved and changed only through authorised change control.
BIA captures impact over time, dependencies, MTPD, RTO/RPO and approvals, and flags invalid or missing data.
A project manager can create WBS, schedule, dependencies, milestones, assignments and forecasts.
Resource managers can view demand/capacity and resolve allocation conflicts.
Finance can reconcile project actuals/commitments and review forecast calculations.
A change request produces an impact assessment and updates affected records only after approval.
SOP, user guide and process flow can be generated from controlled project/process data and published through approval.
UAT evidence, defects and business acceptance are traceable to approved requirements.
Go-live cannot be approved where configured mandatory readiness evidence is missing or an authorised exception is absent.
All material approvals, changes, financial adjustments and administrative actions are auditable.
AI-generated recommendations cite source records and cannot execute restricted approval actions.
Authorised users can export complete project records and associated documents without breaking relationships.
Product catalogue

Create and maintain a central product register with unique product ID, name, description, type, domain, owner, sponsor, lifecycle status, criticality, business unit, geography, customer segments and linked services.
Product hierarchy
Support product portfolios, product lines, products, modules/components, platforms and services with parent-child relationships and configurable hierarchy.
Product profile
Maintain vision, mission, value proposition, target users, personas, jobs-to-be-done, problem statements, differentiators, channels, constraints and product principles.
Product ownership
Assign Product Manager, Product Owner, business owner, technical owner, service owner, data owner and commercial owner with effective dates and delegation history.
Idea intake
Provide configurable idea submission forms for employees, customers, partners and management; capture source, attachments, category, expected value, urgency and affected products.
Idea triage
Support duplicate detection, categorisation, scoring, comments, triage meetings, decisions, rejection reasons, deferral dates and conversion to discovery item.
Customer and stakeholder insights
Maintain stakeholder groups, customer segments, personas, interview plans, research notes, feedback themes, consent/permission metadata and evidence links.
Opportunity management
Record opportunities with problem, affected segment, evidence, reach, impact, confidence, strategic fit, urgency, effort and measurable opportunity outcome.
Discovery management
Plan and track discovery activities, hypotheses, assumptions, research tasks, prototypes, experiments, findings, decisions and evidence.
Hypothesis register
Record hypothesis statement, user segment, expected behaviour/outcome, measurement method, baseline, target, owner, status and validation evidence.
Experiment management
Define experiment design, sample/segment, control and treatment where relevant, duration, guardrails, success thresholds, results and decision. Support ethical and privacy review.
Product strategy
Maintain product vision, strategic objectives, strategic themes, positioning, target segments, strategic constraints and alignment to organisation strategy.
Product business case
Capture problem/opportunity, options, expected benefits, cost, revenue, savings, TCO, NPV/ROI where applicable, assumptions, sensitivity, risks, funding request and approval.
Product portfolio
View products by strategic fit, lifecycle, value, cost, risk, technical health, customer impact, revenue and investment; support portfolio review and investment decisions.
Roadmap
Create outcome-based roadmaps by product, portfolio, audience and time horizon; support Now/Next/Later and date-based views, confidence levels, dependencies and scenario alternatives.
Roadmap governance
Version roadmaps, record approvals, changes, rationale, impact, stakeholder communications and superseded commitments.
Prioritisation
Provide configurable scoring models such as RICE, WSJF, MoSCoW, value-versus-effort and weighted scorecards; allow custom weights, explainable score calculations and override audit trail.
Outcome and OKR alignment
Link product objectives and key results to corporate objectives, measurable outcomes, initiatives, releases and dashboards; track baseline, target, actual and confidence.
Product requirements
Capture product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, non-functional requirements, personas, source, rationale, priority and traceability.
Backlog management
Manage themes, initiatives, epics, capabilities, features, stories, defects, technical enablers and research tasks; support hierarchy, dependencies, estimation and prioritisation.
Product-to-project linkage
Convert approved initiatives into projects/programmes or link to existing delivery work; retain two-way traceability between product outcomes and project scope/deliverables.
Continuous delivery linkage
Support product teams delivering through persistent backlogs and releases without requiring a new project for every change.
Release management
Plan releases, versions, scope, release notes, environments, deployment windows, dependencies, approvals, readiness checklist, rollback and release outcome.
Launch management
Manage launch plans, target audiences, channels, communications, training, sales/operations enablement, support readiness, FAQs, launch risks and post-launch review.
Adoption management
Track eligible users, active users, activation, onboarding completion, feature adoption, retention, engagement and segment-level adoption against targets.
Product analytics
Define metrics, event taxonomy, data source, owner, calculation, refresh frequency, baseline, target and thresholds; display trends and segment breakdowns.
Voice of customer
Consolidate feedback, complaints, surveys, support tickets, app reviews and relationship-manager input; classify themes and link feedback to opportunities and backlog.
Product health
Provide configurable health score using adoption, customer satisfaction, reliability, security, cost, delivery predictability, technical debt and business performance.
Technical debt
Register technical debt items with risk, impact, remediation estimate, affected components, owner and planned capacity; report debt trend and ageing.
Product financials
Track product budget, operating cost, capital cost, cloud/vendor cost, revenue, margin, unit economics, forecast, actuals and allocation rules.
Pricing and commercial model
Where applicable, record pricing models, tiers, packages, discounts, contracts, monetisation assumptions, approvals and effective dates; restrict sensitive commercial access.
Product risk and compliance
Maintain product-level risks covering privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory, legal, accessibility, third-party, data, operational, reputational and continuity concerns.
Product BIA

Capture critical business services supported, impact of product unavailability, maximum tolerable period of disruption, RTO/RPO requirements, dependencies, workarounds, recovery priorities and evidence; link to enterprise BIA and continuity plans.
Operational readiness

Require service owner, support hours, service levels, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, SOPs, user guides, knowledge articles, backup/recovery, access model and support escalation before production acceptance.
Product documentation
Maintain version-controlled product charter, PRD, UX artefacts, architecture, API specifications, data dictionary, SOP, user guide, process flow, release notes and support documentation.
Product change management
Assess proposed product changes for customer, scope, roadmap, cost, schedule, architecture, security, compliance, BIA, operations and benefits impact; route through configurable approvals.
Product lifecycle review
Schedule periodic reviews and trigger reviews on poor performance, major incidents, regulatory changes, vendor end-of-life, cost overruns or strategic shifts.
Sunset and retirement
Manage end-of-life decision, customer notice, migration, data export/retention, contract/vendor closure, decommission, access removal, archive and residual risk acceptance.
Product governance
Support product councils, portfolio boards, design authority and investment committees with agenda, papers, decisions, actions, minutes and decision history.
Product reporting
Provide executive, portfolio, product, discovery, roadmap, delivery, adoption, financial, risk and health dashboards with role-based filtering and export.
Product collaboration
Provide comments, mentions, tasks, approvals, decision logs, meeting notes, notifications and subscriptions linked to product records.
Product templates
Allow configurable templates for product charter, discovery brief, business case, PRD, roadmap, experiment, launch plan, health review and retirement plan.
Product access control
Apply role-based and attribute-based permissions to product, financial, customer research, commercial, security and personal data.
Product audit trail
Log creation, updates, status changes, score changes, roadmap changes, approvals, access-sensitive actions and data exports with actor and timestamp.
AI product assistant

Assist with idea clustering, research synthesis, draft personas, requirement quality checks, roadmap options, release summaries and product health insights; require human review and preserve source/evidence links.
